objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, or other controlled document in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document abbreviation used with the consecutive number.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Consecutive number assigned to the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle or workflow status of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which a released document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate the validity end date.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which an invalidated document is archived.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating a document, such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template selectable when creating a new document object for a document type.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: Version of a document created, edited, released, invalidated, archived, or reactivated during its lifecycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attachment that is released with the main document and has its own versioning.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary information for a document that is directly released and published via properties and has no release cycle.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person participating in document creation, review, release, translation, distribution, acknowledgement, or administration.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role or license role assigned to the user.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used for reader, author, reviewer, releaser, archive, business admin, distribution, or authorization assignment.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for changes to an existing released or validated document.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request to check and extend the validity of a document.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request to invalidate and archive a released document.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of users and user groups assigned to document distribution by e-mail or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Workflow-supported confirmation that a distributed document has been acknowledged.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature completed by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to a participant during release, validity extension, override, reactivation, translation, or acknowledgement workflows.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data item referenced in document properties.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system where document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated language-dependent version of a released document.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attach a new information object, select document type and template, and create a document in the system.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific metadata and authorization-related attributes of a document.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Open and modify document content using the editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF for web display.

evts.name: link_document
evts.description: Link a document with processes, organizational units, risks, IT applications, master data, or other documents.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related rights for readers, authors, co-authors, reviewers, releasers, or translators.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Create supplementary additional information for a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Create a controlled attachment for a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment for archiving and archive it with release of the next main document version.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Start the three-step release workflow for a document after creation and maintenance.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs the creation step of the release workflow.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks a document according to technical or formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser approves and releases a document.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a released document so addressed readers can see it.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid released document by creating an editing version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document without affecting document content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Document the editing of an assigned change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System creates a request thirty days before document validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request, and update the document valid-until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Create a request for override for a document to be invalidated.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declare a document out of force, archive it, revoke rights except archive group, and retain the request for documentation.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Create a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Confirm reactivation, create a new document version, restore authorizations, distribution assignments, and archived attachments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Assign users and user groups to document distribution by e-mail or acknowledgement.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Notify assigned users and users in assigned groups by e-mail when a new version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request acknowledgement from assigned persons and user groups on release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement of the document without a signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released document content into another language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check a translated language version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release a translated language version so it is visible to authorized readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify the clients in which a document is visible.

o2o.description: A document is created with a selected document type.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
A document is managed in versions.
Attachments belong to a main document.
Additional information supplements a document.
A change proposal clearly belongs to a document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for override is created for a selected document.
A request for reactivation selects the corresponding invalidated document.
The distribution list is maintained per document.
Persons can be assigned to a distribution list.
User groups can be assigned to a distribution list.
Users can be assigned to user groups.
Authors, co-authors, reviewers, releasers, translators, readers, and initiators can be maintained on or assigned to a document.
Reader, authorization, distribution, archive, and role groups can be assigned to documents.
Documents can be linked with processes.
Documents can be linked with organizational units.
Documents can be linked with risks.
Documents can reference IT applications in their properties.
Documents can reference or be linked to other documents.
A document can have visibility specified for clients in a multi-client system.
Released documents can have language-dependent translated versions.
Signatures are documented for each released version.
Acknowledgements refer to the current version of a distributed document.
